# Desktop application shell

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:recipe-app-shell` · Kerf UI · production recipe · Recipes

## When to use

App bar above a Workbench with resizable navigation and inspector rails, relocated rail toggles, narrow-container overlays, and explicit pane scroll owners.

- A desktop workspace needs persistent chrome and user-adjustable navigation or inspector panes.

**Not when:**

- Use ordinary CSS grid when panes are static or the product does not need a user-operable separator.

## Imports

- Nothing to import: this is a reference composition.
- Declared side effects: lazy-recipe-css.

## Props

No props: this entry has no JavaScript API.

## Composition

- Parents: used at the root of a screen or reference, not nested.
- Contexts: `application-reference`.
- Children: unrestricted.
- Built from: [Pane](./pane.md), [Toolbar](./toolbar.md), [ToolbarText](./toolbar-text.md), [ToolbarControlGroup](./toolbar-control-group.md), [Workbench](./workbench.md), [List](./list.md), [ListItem](./list-item.md), [ValueTable](./value-table.md), [LucideIcon](./lucide-icon.md), [Application layout](./layout.md).

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** routing; pane visibility; pane sizes and persistence; workspace data.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: composed · border: composed · padding: composed (layout role: reference-composition). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

- Each pane has one scroll owner and each resize handle keeps its separator keyboard contract.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
